newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's ENI to cut self-service pump prices.
newsitem.headline: Italy's ENI to cut self-service pump prices.

text.p: Italian energy group ENI will cut the price of petrol by 50 lire a litre at its major self-service distributors from March 29, the company said in a statement.
The cut will initially apply to outlets with self-service facilities run by ENI's units Agip and IP along major roadlinks, including motorways and ring roads.
The reduction will later be applied to other outlets on smaller roads, the statement said.
The average price for a litre of non-leaded petrol in Italy currently costs around 1,918 lire.
